stories.headline: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Early Trade
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Indian shares were modestly higher on Tuesday despite weak cues from global markets.

stories.headline: Kalshi Readies Stock Trading Launch After Quietly Buying Broker in July
stories.body: Prediction markets platform Kalshi bought New York-based broker FB Securities in July and plans to expand into stock trading within the next two months, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday (Nov. 16), citing unnamed sources. stories.headline: Richard Neiman, regulator during 2008 crisis, dies at 76
stories.body: Richard Neiman, a former New York State Superintendent of Banks and member of the Congressional Oversight Panel for the Troubled Asset Relief Program, died after a long illness.
